sources.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B: Open 33B Agent Model, 80.9 on Terminal-Bench ...
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.3-33B is a new open-weight dense model released on October 24, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license, built for coding and office-style agents. The model card on Hugging Face reports that it leads three comparable 30B-class models on most agentic benchmarks, including 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1.

sources.title: Nanbeige Opens 33B Model With Apache 2.0 and 512K Context, Claims Wins ...
sources.snippet: Summary Chinese AI lab Nanbeige, backed by recruitment platform BOSS Zhipin, released Nanbeige4.3-33B on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0 with a 524,288-token context window and reasoning mode on by default.

sources.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B arrives open source and takes on Qwen3.8-27B in coding
sources.snippet: How much memory does Nanbeige4.3-33B need to run locally? Nanbeige4.3-33B weighs about 66 GB in BF16 and around 20 GB with 4-bit quantization, plus the KV cache (the memory where the model keeps track of the context), which for this model costs about 208 KB for every token.
